label: 🔭 FITS
description: Read FITS files (.fits, .fit, .fts) — astronomical observations and catalogues. A FITS file is a list of HDUs (Header-Data Units): some are images, some are tables. By default the connector picks the first BinTable / ASCIITable HDU; if there are none, the first 2-D image HDU. Use 'hdu' to override by index. Requires the [science] extra (astropy).

hdu.label: HDU index
hdu.help: Zero-based index of the HDU to read. Default: the first table HDU, or the first image HDU if no tables are present.
